extraction.name: AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes
extraction.description: A large and varied database of human motion that unifies 15 different optical marker-based mocap datasets by representing them within a common framework and parameterization.
extraction.creator: Naureen Mahmood, Nima Ghorbani, Nikolaus F. Troje, Gerard Pons-Moll, Michael J. Black
extraction.publisher: MPI for Intelligent Systems, Meshcapade GmbH, York University
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is a unification of 15 existing motion capture datasets, which were collected using various optical marker-based mocap systems.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Direct measurement, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Some datasets had missing or occluded markers, which were handled during the unification process.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of sparse markers from various mocap datasets.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The timeframe for collecting the individual datasets varies, but the unified dataset AMASS has 42 hours of motion data.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: Missing markers were handled through manual inspection and correction during the unification process.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The data was manipulated to fit a common framework and parameterization using the SMPL body model.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data was preprocessed to remove inconsistencies and unify the datasets.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset was annotated with SMPL pose, shape, and soft-tissue parameters.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The annotations were analyzed to ensure consistency and accuracy across the unified dataset.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will be continuously updated with new captures, and the community is encouraged to contribute.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains sensitive human attributes such as body shape, pose, and soft-tissue dynamics.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset has the potential to impact various applications in computer vision, animation, and robotics.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may contain biases due to the varying quality and characteristics of the individual mocap datasets.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has limitations in terms of the accuracy and completeness of the mocap data, particularly in cases of marker occlusion or missing data.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training deep learning models, animation, visualization, and generating training data for computer vision tasks.
